Thirty-five years after my first academic appointment at Universidade Federal de Pelotas , I’m very pleased to be returning to academia. From September 8th, I have joined City St George’s, University of London , as Honorary Senior Lecturer in the Centre for Biomedical Education. The role is especially appealing because it sits at the intersection of two parts of my career: academia and the life-sciences industry. I’ll be contributing to academic–industry partnerships, student placements, teaching in areas such as clinical trials, systematic reviews and drug development, and wider collaborations in research, education and innovation. That also connects naturally with my work at Pulsus Pharma Consultancy , where we try to bring together scientific rigour, academic perspective and practical experience of how medicines are developed and used. I’m very grateful to Androulla Elia and Alexis Bailey for their guidance and support in making this appointment possible. I’m looking forward to this new chapter and to the opportunities it may create for closer collaboration between universities and industry.

Nous sommes heureux d’annoncer la nomination de Gondje Hendriks au poste de Directrice Générale de Zoetis France, à compter du 1er septembre 2026. Cette nomination s’inscrit dans une évolution importante : Zoetis France rejoint le nouveau Cluster Europe du Nord-Ouest (North West EU), aux côtés de la Belgique, des Pays-Bas, du Luxembourg, de l’Irlande et des pays nordiques. Ce nouveau cadre régional nous permettra de partager encore davantage de meilleures pratiques, accélérer l’innovation et créer plus de valeur pour nos clients et les animaux dont ils prennent soin. Actuellement Vice-Présidente du cluster BNNI, Gondje assurera le poste de DG France, en complément de ses responsabilités de Vice-Présidente North West EU. Nous remercions chaleureusement Johan Van den Branden , pour les bases solides posées ces trois dernières années. Bienvenue à Gondje dans ses nouvelles fonctions. #ZoetisFrance #ZoetisProud Veuillez noter que le contenu de ce post est destiné uniquement aux publics en France.
linkedin_activity.text_en: We are pleased to announce the appointment of Gondje Hendriks as Managing Director of Zoetis France, effective September 1, 2026. This appointment is part of an important evolution: Zoetis France joins the new North West Europe Cluster (North West EU), alongside Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Nordic countries. This new regional framework will allow us to share even more best practices, accelerate innovation and create more value for our customers and the animals they care for. Currently Vice-President of the BNNI cluster, Gondje will assume the position of DG France, in addition to her responsibilities as Vice-President North West EU. We warmly thank Johan Van den Branden , for the solid foundations laid over the last three years. Welcome to Gondje in her new role. #ZoetisFrance #ZoetisProud Please note that the content of this post is intended for audiences in France only.
